subject: PO and invoice laddering for MediCorp - discount recognition and net terms
messages:
From: Elaine Chu <elaine.chu@medicorp.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: PO.finance@medicorp.com
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Blanket PO proposal + invoice cadence question

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team was impressed. Procurement is getting ahead of the paperwork so we can kick off in early October. Attached is a draft blanket PO (PO_Draft_MediCorp_8247.pdf) that references milestone delivery and a monthly invoicing cadence. Two open items from our side we need you to confirm:

- Net terms: Procurement policy defaults to Net60 for vendors on enterprise agreements. Can Redwood accept Net60 for this engagement?
- Discount recognition: We have a spend-based discount ladder in the PO (20% at $600k, 25% at $1M). Our AP team needs to know if discounts can be applied prorata on each monthly invoice as spend accrues, or if Redwood requires a single reconciliation invoice at the end of the commitment period to apply the full discount.

Also cc'd is our AP mailbox — they may send over remittance details or tax/PO formatting constraints.

Can you confirm feasibility and any invoice/PO formatting requirements so I can push this through our systems before quarter-end?

Best,
Elaine
Elaine Chu
Senior Procurement Manager, MediCorp Health
Elaine.Chu@medicorp.com

Attachment: PO_Draft_MediCorp_8247.pdf (1.2 MB)
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Chu <elaine.chu@medicorp.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, PO.finance@medicorp.com
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Blanket PO proposal + invoice cadence question

Hi Elaine — thanks for the PO and context. Quick summary from our side after a short sync with Finance and Sales Ops:

- Net terms: Our standard is Net30. We can accommodate Net60 for enterprise customers, but that requires a signed credit amendment (standard clause) and approval from Finance. If your preference is Net60, we'll need the signed amendment before the first invoice.

- Discount application: We generally apply discounts at the time an invoice is issued. That means we can prorate a spend-based discount across monthly invoices as spend accrues (i.e., apply the trailing prorated percentage each month based on cumulative spend to date), provided the PO has clear line-item references and the discount ladder is unambiguous. Alternatively, we can do a reconciliation credit at the end of the term if your AP/ERP prefers end-of-period accounting.

- Invoice formatting: Finance prefers one invoice per month referencing the PO number and the specific PO line items covered by that invoice. For split invoices against a single blanket PO, each invoice must include the PO line reference so your ERP can auto-apply payment. Ben will share our invoice template.

Options to move forward (pick one):
1) Net60 + monthly invoices with prorated discount applied each invoice — requires signed credit amendment up front.
2) Net30 or Net45 + monthly invoices with end-of-term reconciliation credit — no amendment needed for Net30; Net45 requires manager approval.

If you need quicker acceptance of discount for quarter reporting, option 1 is possible but we'll need the signed amendment and a short SOW addendum indicating the ladder thresholds and how to calculate prorated credits.

I can jump on a 30-min call tomorrow to finalize. Marissa — looping you to coordinate commercial docs / SOW. Ben — can you attach the invoice template and any finance notes?

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai

Attachment: none
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, PO.finance@medicorp.com
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 12:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Blanket PO proposal + invoice cadence question

Elaine / Jonas — attaching our invoice template and a short note on PO/invoice requirements. Summary:

- Required fields on invoice: Redwood vendor TIN, your PO number (exact match), PO line reference for each invoice line, invoice number, invoice date, payment terms, remittance instructions.
- Split invoices against a single PO: ERP systems at some customers require each invoice to reference the PO line item(s) and the remaining balance. Please make sure the PO lines are granular if you expect multiple partial invoices per line.
- Discounts: We can apply prorated discounts on each invoice. We calculate the prorated discount as (accrued spend / threshold) * threshold discount, rounded to two decimals. Any final true-up will be applied as a credit memo on the invoice following the quarter close if thresholds were met mid-month.
- Tax & remittance: Send remittance information to finance@redwood.ai with your account code. If you require separate legal entity names on invoices, note that in the PO.

See attached: Redwood_invoice_template.xlsx (Excel template) and a one-page Finance note. If you prefer Net45 instead of Net60, we can often approve Net45 internally without an amendment; Net60 triggers a credit review.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Attachment: Redwood_invoice_template.xlsx (12 KB)
From: Elaine Chu <elaine.chu@medicorp.com>

Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Blanket PO proposal + invoice cadence question

Thanks Jonas / Ben — this is helpful. Two clarifications from Procurement and AP: 

1) MediCorp would prefer Net45 if that avoids the amendment step (quarter-end timing is tight). If Net45 is permissible without additional credit docs, that's our preferred route.
2) For discounts: we are willing to accept prorated discounts on monthly invoices as long as there is a final true-up credit if the cumulative spend exceeds a tier within the commitment period. So monthly prorata + quarter-end true-up is our preference.

We have a short internal requirement: to start recognizing the discount as of the first invoice (provisioned against month-to-date accruals). If Redwood can apply prorata immediately, we can align internal reporting.

I’ve also uploaded the signed PO draft to DocuSign for initial signature from our side: https://na1.docusign.net/participant/invitation?doc=PO8247

Can Redwood confirm Net45 approval and whether we should expect invoices with prorated discount applied from the first invoice? If yes, I'll route the PO for signature today.

Best,
Elaine

Subject: Re: Blanket PO proposal + invoice cadence question

Elaine — good news. Finance has approved Net45 for MediCorp without a formal credit amendment given the size and strategic nature of the account, subject to the PO including the legal entity and exact PO line breakdowns. Confirmed items:

- Net terms: Net45 accepted. We'll proceed once the signed PO is returned.
- Invoice cadence: Monthly invoices referencing the blanket PO and specific PO line items.
- Discount recognition: Redwood will apply prorated discounts on each invoice starting with the first invoice (per the calculation Ben outlined). We will issue a quarter-end true-up credit memo for any threshold overruns or final adjustments.

Next steps:
1) Elaine — please ensure the PO includes PO line granularity (units, description, unit price) so partial invoicing maps cleanly to your ERP.
2) We will attach Amendment-PO8247-draft.docx to the final contract package to reflect Net45 and the prorated discount approach (for audit trace). Marissa will drop the SOW addendum showing ladder thresholds and the prorata formula.
3) Once signed, Redwood will issue the first invoice on the following calendar month with the prorated discount applied.

Marissa — please coordinate the Amendment doc and SOW addendum. Ben — once the signed PO arrives, prepare the invoice schedule template and send remittance instructions.

Thanks — looking forward to get this live.

Jonas
Jonas Weber
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
